top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a complete, mature chain from identification of the active GLP-1 peptides and incretin physiology to therapies with proven benefit in type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a clean three-laureate allocation (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov) and a citation scoped to the physiology of GLP-1 and its active forms. It is the only substantive proposal on the slate and clearly preferable to no award.
